name: Sill Line, Wired
tagline: The family's week is a lit wire: the tube drops it onto stop one, every plan stands on the sill in one grammar, and the lists below hang from short tracks of their own.
concept: The board still stands on its sill, lit only from now to stop one. Every plan on it is one kind of thing: a plate on a steel post over its ring stop, its top level with plate one's glass. The Next up tube is plate one, in glass, and its power lamp drops the lit wire onto the rail. Above the sill the box is lit glass with a line of the machine's own on it. Below the sill, every list hangs from one kind of short track (a rail in the gutter, a ring on the rule head's line, a T under the last row, one lamp), on Home, To do, Plans and Status alike. Every page ends on the machine's status, set on a stub of the same rail: a calm signal box at night, lit only on the wire that matters.
companions: Steel #56708c draws the rails, the plates' posts, the ring stops, the tick squares and the T buffers. Ink plates (#1a2230) carry a bone cap (#cfc6b0 at 70%) in place of the navy one: on Home's plates, on the month's events, on the Plans list's rows (as a left cap) and on the family's chat lines. Each kind's grounded colour is drawn as its icon in a 20px ring on every plate: trip and day trip cyan #70dcf4, show pink #ff9fd0, outing moss #b5c87d, activity lemon, restaurant amber. On the month it is a solid 8px kind dot, and on Lately added it is the ring and the word. Amber is kept for late words, the setup strip's edge and current ring, 'needs a look' and the foot lamp's trouble state. Sage marks 'now' and done. The bright #6dff9c stays on the mark, Send and the primaries, the lit word 'plan', the box's glass edge and its '›' prompt, the figures and cursor of the glass status line, the now lamps, the lit run and wire to stop one (on Home, on the month and on the Plans list), the tube, To do's now line, Lately's newest lamp, the foot's Ready lamp and focus.
title: What needs a *plan*? Tell Vera. 'What needs a plan?' is set as the display line with 'plan' lit and the '?' in ink, and 'Tell Vera.' sits on its baseline at half size in ink-2 as the box's spoken label (it drops under the line on the phone). It says FamilyDB's job: whatever needs arranging, a weekend, a reminder, an idea, a wish, is handed to Vera here, and the lit word sits over the lit run of plans that answers it.
decisions: Started from x14a-sill-cross. The new rules are one source, src/wired.css, appended last by build.py. Superseded rules were deleted from the older sources rather than overridden (the parent's sill, plate, foot, plans-list and To do head rules among them). build.py now also drops any base declaration a later rule with the same selector and @media sets again. That freed about 6 KB, so the sheet is 196 KB of the 200 KB limit with the new Plans list and track rules included.

One grammar for every plan. Each plate is a 20px ring with its kind's icon in the kind's colour, the name in Archivo 75% 600 at 1.125rem (balanced, 'Mount St. Helens' unbroken), 'for Maya' in dim, then the foot: the day numeral (DM Mono 1.5rem, month over weekday in .75rem label caps) beside the time (DM Mono, body size) over 'in 7 days' (sans, dim). The tracked-caps kind word and the sunk chip are gone. The whole plate is the link, with a 2px phosphor focus ring, and hover lifts it to surface-3 with its cap going bone. Home's phone rows and the Plans list use the same order.

The plates stand on posts. Their tops are level with plate one's bezel, and each has a 1px steel post from under its ring down to its ring stop on the rail. A taller tube makes longer posts, not empty graphite, so the row reads as one row of stops (the 14a lesson: shrink or add, never stretch).

The Next up tube is plate one in the same order on the glass (VT323): the NEXT UP tag, the kind's icon in a phosphor ring and the name, 'for Maya, Theo' at 82% dim phosphor, then the day numeral beside 13:00 over [IN 2 DAYS] and the cursor. Its radar is a 64px corner graticule, so the tube narrows to 21rem. Its power lamp drops a 2px lit wire straight onto stop one's lit ring (Ticked's drop). The run from the now lamp to stop one is the only lit run, with the kit's bloom (6px at 60%, 18px at 25%) and airglow masked to it. The now lamp breathes at 2.4s with a white-hot core.

The station head is a rule head across the whole sill: 'Coming up', the steel rule, then '4 coming · next Sun 4 Oct 13:00' on its baseline, with the Calendar note under it (on the phone the note moves below the rail, so plate one stays on the first screen).

The box is glass lit from beneath (L092): the field, an inset bottom-weighted glow, a 1px phosphor top highlight faded at both ends, and its resting halo cut further. A lit DM Mono '›' leads the placeholder (L095). Folio's tube status is rebuilt inside the box's foot in DM Mono .8125rem: '4 plans · 3 late · Vera is listening'. Its words are steel-grey dim and only the figures and the blinking block cursor are lit, so it is a line on the glass, not more green. It reads 'answering' while a turn runs and is aria-hidden.
The placeholder is 'Plans, an idea, a reminder…'. The brief's '…the calendar…' is about 360px at the box's size and cannot stay on one line in the phone's 260px.

One geometry for every short track, the line's own rule for lists under the sill. The rail runs in the section's left gutter. A 10px ring sits where it meets the rule head's line, the head is set 3rem in, the rows hang to the rail's right, a T buffer sits under the last row, and there is one lamp. Things that are stops sit on the rail as rings (Lately's ideas, the kids' wishes behind a pink gift ring). To do's ticks are controls in their own column, clear of the rail, so nothing strikes through 'Done'. To do's lamp is its now line, which leaves the rail at a breathing lit dot with 'now' set on the line. The same track carries /tasks, with its panel dropped and the ring at its column heads, and Status and Settings lose their boxes for rules.
Column heads are sentence case, 12px Archivo 600 in label ink, untracked, on one baseline: Day, Done (centred over the ticks, 16px clear of Day), Thing to do, Who, Due, and Edit on the page only.

Every page's foot is the machine's status (Plate, Engraved), set on a 3.5rem stub of the sill's rail from a breathing 8px Ready lamp to a T: 'Ready · OpenAI gpt-6-luna · $0.00 of $2.00 today' with DM Mono figures, and 'Status →' at the right. Lamp and word turn amber or red for an admin when there is trouble. The lamp key shows only where lamps are drawn, and the mark, the copyright and the motto share one line beneath.

Plans. On the month each event plate carries an 8px dot in its kind's colour (the kind now reaches the month: Nutcracker is show-pink, Oaks Park activity-lemon), and the NOW run ends in the same lit ring as Home's stop one: phosphor edge, the 6px and 18px bloom, a white-hot core. The List view is rebuilt on the same grammar, unboxed: the day numeral in the margin, the ring on the rail (the first one lit at the end of the now run), then an ink plate with a bone left cap holding the kind ring, the name, and the time over how far off. Gaps of a week or more still fold to a dashed run.

Phone. The order is the title with 'Tell Vera.' under it; then the box, one line that grows with no resize grip and no status line under 30rem, with the 'From' label for screen readers only; then the starters as one scrolling row of shrink-wrapped 44px keys with scroll-snap and a right-edge fade; then the sill down the left gutter. A layout bug left the phone's lit run running the whole rail with no wire; it is fixed (an absolutely placed grid item needs an explicit end line), so the run is lit only from 'now' down to stop one, where the tube's wire comes in from its power lamp. The whole tube (name, people, day and time) is on the first 844px screen.

Status. Lamp-board row names are DM Mono .8125rem and lamp names 12px DM Mono instead of VT323. The meter's pane is a fixed 23rem, so the dial is shorter and the lamp board's glass no longer has 90px of dead glass above and below its rows. The average is said once, as 'avg $0.04' outside the arc at the ghost needle's tip, anchored away from the middle, and the duplicate '— Average day' readout is gone. The tallies sit under a 1px rule headed 'Today'. The lists below are unboxed under their rule heads, and only the alert keeps a box.

Palette: plate-cap became bone (rgb(207 198 176 / .7) in the sheet, #99958a as the token), with #cfc6b0 as the hover cap. topGlow went from 0.55 to 0.35. Send's resting halo and the NEXT UP tag's glow are drawn close, while hover and the tag's fill keep the light.
strengths: Every plan in the app is drawn in one grammar: Home's plates, Home's phone rows, the Plans list and the tube share one order (kind ring, name, whom it is for, day numeral, the time over how far off). The tube is the lit first plate of the week, not a second drawing of it.

The light follows the line's own rule and is wired to what it reports. One lit run goes from now to stop one, the wire drops from the tube's power lamp to it, the month and the Plans list end their now runs in the same lit ring, and each list below the sill has exactly one lamp.

One rule for lists that hold no time: they sit unboxed under a rule head and hang from a short track (gutter rail, ring at the head, T under the last row). It holds on Home, To do, Status and Settings, so the standard reaches pages beyond the sheets.
The plates on posts fix the row without stretching: the tops line up with plate one's glass, and the extra height becomes steel posts that make the stops read as stops.
The phone shows the title, the box, the starters and the whole of plate one with its wire on the first screen.

Type is one system: sentence-case column heads on one baseline, Day and Done clear of each other, DM Mono figures everywhere a time or a sum is read, the time at body size, and balanced names on the plates.
weaknesses: Home measures 60.5% green by coloured pixels, a hair over the 60% aimed at. The mark, Send, 'plan', the tube and the lit run carry it, and the brief asked to keep those.
The plates are shorter than plate one, so their posts run about 70px. It reads as a row of signs on posts, but a judge may want the plates fuller instead.

Several things are still worked out in templates by reading the database: the plates' kinds and people on Home, the kinds on the month and the Plans list, the status line's counts, the foot's spend, and To do's absolute dates. Each should be a field from views.py when it ships.
Lately's lamp (a 4px point in the newest ring) is small at 100%. It reads as a lit centre close up but may be missed at a glance.
On the phone, 'Send where I am' still takes a second row in the box, and the starters' row shows the first key and part of the second; the fade is the only cue that it scrolls.
The Status faceplate's two panes still end at different heights, because 'Change the limit' sits under the meter's glass.
The page's words change by about a third on Home (the title's 'Tell Vera.', the placeholder, the status line, the station head's next date, 'Done', the foot's status line).
